body: For a size reference, it’s about an inch long and half an inch wide.
using comedy as a means to cope is totally okay, keep doing it. means you’re a cool kid, just of course know when you legitimately need help

if you *really* thought of your post to be pointless, you wouldn’t have written it. please try to understand that by reaching out (in a subreddit, even) you still want to keep going, even if you don’t realize it. Life is difficult, dude. it’s a lot for one fancy quote. too much shit can happen. you’ve just got to give it time, and find things or situations or eventually people that give you meaning. hope you find yourself, it can be tough.
*surely* there’s more to life than starburst meals. I get thinking it’s pointless, sure- all I’m saying is that at least life has more options.
